context: Maybe an explanation of the naming convention is helpful: In VW[P], we sum of polynomial-size circuits, which describe the class VP. In VW[F], we sum over polynomial size formulas, which define the class VF, the modern name for VPe . We also prove strong separations of algebraic complexity classes and parameterized algebraic complexity classes (Theorem 30), and exponential lower bounds in the parameterized setting (Theorem 36). For VNP it is known that it does not matter whether we sum over formulas or circuits, that is, VNP = VNPe .
